summary: Completed backend + frontend validation for /our-work/workshops-learning against PDF/reference requirements. Core content/placeholder/editor/connect flow passed; one critical responsive/layout regression and one color mismatch found.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow at 1024/1440/1920. Section renders with large right shift (computed margin-left: 371.688px at 1440), causing page scrollWidth > viewport.

integration_issues.issue: Repeated 401s captured only for /api/auth/me during public browsing. Logged for traceability; do not treat as media failure.

issues: Computed intro background is rgb(235, 231, 235), warmer than expected lavender reference/palette #ece7f3.

action_items: Fix Creative Exchange section offset/margin so no horizontal overflow at desktop/tablet widths (1024/1440/1920).
Restore learning-intro lavender to exact approved color (#ece7f3) and prevent unintended override from content styles/rules.
Optionally review anonymous /api/auth/me polling frequency to reduce repeated 401 noise in logs (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: Public API and content migration are correctly wired: workshops page returns expected anchors, hidden notes_feed is excluded, and four placeholders are served with placeholder metadata.
Connect CTA and topic prefill are correctly integrated to /connect?topic=Workshops%20%26%20Learning.
Layout bug appears data/style-driven for block-4 (section-specific margin-left), not a global CSS failure, since adjacent split section (block-3) remains aligned.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: required sections/order, restoration 2-paragraph copy, 4 dummy placeholders, disabled Explore Film pending state, Connect topic prefill, mobile hero ratio 1:1 and heritage 4:3, anchor hashes to heritage/restoration/creative/student work, and live-editor image controls + 8 handles + picker + session persistence. Screenshots captured for middle/bottom hydration states. Home/Craft roots still render (#home-reference, #craft-reference).
rca of the issue:
RCA-1 (critical overflow): Only block-4 (Creative Exchange split-right) gets abnormal computed margin-left (e.g., 371.688px at 1440), shifting entire section right and increasing document scrollWidth (1024=>1266, 1440=>1780, 1920=>2373). Repro: open /our-work/workshops-learning at >=1024 and inspect [data-testid='block-4']; compare with block-3 where margins are zero. Likely persisted section style or section-specific override. Mitigation: clear/normalize block-4 section margin/position style and enforce max-width containment in workshops reference scope.

RCA-2 (intro tone mismatch): #learning-intro computes to rgb(235,231,235) instead of reference lavender #ece7f3, indicating override from another rule/style token. Mitigation: lock intro band background with final specificity for #workshops-reference #learning-intro and verify no runtime style injection alters it.

401 trace log (required): repeated 401 URL observed = https://usp-india-cms.preview.emergentagent.com/api/auth/me (anonymous state).
